title: Sean McVay optimistic that Trent McDuffie will play Sunday vs. Cardinals

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sean McVay optimistic that Trent McDuffie will play Sunday vs. Cardinals
sources.description: Rams cornerback Trent McDuffie has missed three games this season and was listed as a non-participant in Wednesday's practice with a back injury, but the outlook for his ability to play Sunday against the Cardinals is good.
